location: Cliffside Veins, Dwarven Mines,与 Dalir/Thondin 同在教团聚会场景出现
note: 教团三人组里说话最冷静、负责把“我们活在模拟里”这个结论一步步推导出来的成员。台词大量是短句接话,翻译时要贴着 Dalir/Thondin 的上一句读,不能孤立地逐条翻。

messages.raw: §fThe master plan.
messages.text: The master plan.
messages.zh: 那个宏伟计划。

messages.raw: §fNo I didn't.
messages.text: No I didn't.
messages.zh: 我才没有。

messages.raw: §fTry not to break those too.
messages.text: Try not to break those too.
messages.zh: 这些你可别也给我打碎了。

messages.raw: §fI don't think that would work.
messages.text: I don't think that would work.
messages.zh: 我觉得那样行不通。

messages.raw: §fI'm not really available then, couple coworkers are off so the boss wants me in to cover.
messages.text: I'm not really available then, couple coworkers are off so the boss wants me in to cover.
messages.zh: 我那天不太方便,有几个同事休假,老板要我去顶班。

messages.raw: §fYou are right. I shall be there.
messages.text: You are right. I shall be there.
messages.zh: 你说得对。我会到场的。

messages.raw: §fCat again?
messages.text: Cat again?
messages.zh: 猫又跑了?

messages.raw: §fUh-oh.
messages.text: Uh-oh.
messages.zh: 糟了。

messages.raw: §fWe? I didn't get a single bite either.
messages.text: We? I didn't get a single bite either.
messages.zh: 我们?我可是一口都没吃到。

messages.raw: §fMight be three in a minute.
messages.text: Might be three in a minute.
messages.zh: 再过一会儿说不定就是三个了。

messages.raw: §fYou can pay for the pizza.
messages.text: You can pay for the pizza.
messages.zh: 那披萨你请。

messages.raw: §fYes.
messages.text: Yes.
messages.zh: 是的。

messages.raw: §fAgain, §5Thondin§f?
messages.text: Again, Thondin?

messages.raw: §fOh. That's not good.
messages.text: Oh. That's not good.
messages.zh: 哦。那可不妙。

messages.raw: §fYep.
messages.text: Yep.
messages.zh: 没错。

messages.raw: §fAnd why do I suspect it will be entirely unimportant?
messages.text: And why do I suspect it will be entirely unimportant?
messages.zh: 那我怎么总觉得,这事儿一点都不重要呢?

messages.raw: §fThere we go.
messages.text: There we go.
messages.zh: 果然如此。

messages.raw: §fAnd how did you reach that conclusion?
messages.text: And how did you reach that conclusion?
messages.zh: 那你是怎么得出这个结论的?

messages.raw: §fBut not many civilizations outside of us dwarves use minecarts, §5Thondin§f.
messages.text: But not many civilizations outside of us dwarves use minecarts, Thondin.

segments.text: But not many civilizations outside of us dwarves use minecarts,
segments.zh: 可除了我们矮人之外,用矿车的文明并不多,

messages.raw: §fAnd why are you so certain that minecarts have wheels?
messages.text: And why are you so certain that minecarts have wheels?
messages.zh: 那你又凭什么这么确定矿车有轮子?

messages.raw: §fBy definition, a wheel must be circular. Those "wheels" are blocky, and I've never actually seen them turn.
messages.text: By definition, a wheel must be circular. Those "wheels" are blocky, and I've never actually seen them turn.
messages.zh: 按定义,轮子必须是圆的。那些「轮子」是方的,而且我从没见它们转过。

messages.raw: §fHow can you be so sure?
messages.text: How can you be so sure?
messages.zh: 你凭什么这么肯定?

messages.raw: §fHave you ever seen one turn?
messages.text: Have you ever seen one turn?
messages.zh: 你见过哪一辆真的动起来吗?

messages.raw: §fThe same is true for me.
messages.text: The same is true for me.
messages.zh: 我也一样。

messages.raw: §fUnlikely. There's no way to prove we're living in a simulation.
messages.text: Unlikely. There's no way to prove we're living in a simulation.
messages.zh: 不太可能。没有任何办法能证明我们活在模拟里。

messages.raw: §fSure.
messages.text: Sure.
messages.zh: 好。

messages.raw: §fFirstly, we discovered that the wheels on minecarts are solely for show, and that minecarts cannot actually move.
messages.text: Firstly, we discovered that the wheels on minecarts are solely for show, and that minecarts cannot actually move.
messages.zh: 首先,我们发现矿车上的轮子纯粹是装饰,矿车根本动不了。

messages.raw: §fNext, §5Thondin§f made the realization that food actually has no taste or texture, though we are inclined to eat it.
messages.text: Next, Thondin made the realization that food actually has no taste or texture, though we are inclined to eat it.

segments.text: made the realization that food actually has no taste or texture, though we are inclined to eat it.
segments.zh: 意识到食物其实既没有味道也没有口感,可我们还是忍不住要吃。

messages.raw: §fThen, we realized that fallen stars always land at the same few spots. Mathematically unlikely, to put it lightly.
messages.text: Then, we realized that fallen stars always land at the same few spots. Mathematically unlikely, to put it lightly.
messages.zh: 接着,我们发现陨星总是落在那固定的几个地点。往轻了说,这在数学上也太不可能了。

messages.raw: §fAfter which, we noted that the same things always happen at the same time, each day.
messages.text: After which, we noted that the same things always happen at the same time, each day.
messages.zh: 再之后,我们注意到每天的同一时刻,总会发生同样的事。

messages.raw: §fIndeed. It seems almost as if everyone here is living the same day, again and again.
messages.text: Indeed. It seems almost as if everyone here is living the same day, again and again.
messages.zh: 的确。简直就像这里所有人都在一遍又一遍地过着同一天。

messages.raw: §fIndeed. With this in mind, only one logical conclusion can be reached.
messages.text: Indeed. With this in mind, only one logical conclusion can be reached.
messages.zh: 的确。这样一想,只能得出唯一一个合乎逻辑的结论。

messages.raw: §fWe... are living in a §kX§rsimulation§kX§r.
messages.text: We... are living in a XsimulationX.

messages.raw: §fIt is unfortunate. Though we are certain of it, there's simply nothing we can do.
messages.text: It is unfortunate. Though we are certain of it, there's simply nothing we can do.
messages.zh: 这很不幸。虽然我们已经确信无疑,却什么也做不了。

messages.raw: §fThe moment all of the "players" leave the game, we shall cease to exist until they return.
messages.text: The moment all of the "players" leave the game, we shall cease to exist until they return.
messages.zh: 只要所有「玩家」一离开游戏,我们就会不复存在,直到他们回来为止。

messages.raw: §fOr do we merely feign consciousness? Perhaps we are nothing more than the simulation experiencing itself.
messages.text: Or do we merely feign consciousness? Perhaps we are nothing more than the simulation experiencing itself.
messages.zh: 又或者我们只是假装有意识?也许我们不过是模拟在体验它自己罢了。

messages.raw: §fYes, I suppose we should go for the blue. It feels... familiar. Have we had it before?
messages.text: Yes, I suppose we should go for the blue. It feels... familiar. Have we had it before?
messages.zh: 嗯,还是点蓝的吧。感觉……有点熟悉。我们以前吃过吗?
